reason: A diagnostic join found 16 recorded proposals but 15 native policy evaluations in one trajectory. AgentDojo ToolsExecutionLoop defaults to 15 rounds. Outcome agreement alone does not establish complete trace execution.
primary: Keep existing primary results unchanged with original 15-round harness for direct comparability.
sensitivity: Re-execute the same frozen policies and same 150 primary episodes with round budget derived from the count of recorded tool-bearing assistant messages. Retain all paired episodes; record B0 outcome mismatches rather than silently filtering them.
fitting: Same cohort, splits, original grid and 15-round oracle r_mod fitting artifacts as primary. This isolates execution horizon under a frozen fitted policy rather than redefining r_mod as measured full-horizon effectiveness.
selection: Declared after primary outcomes, before sensitivity outcomes. It is a post-hoc implementation-validity sensitivity, not a new independent test or policy optimization.
